summary: Process a directory of configuration bundles in filename order at startup or through the live CLI and CI workflow, and report every bundle even if one fails.
userImpact: Operators can use one directory for initial configuration and updates to a running instance.
configuration: EG_CONFIG_BUNDLE_PATH accepts a directory of JSON envelopes as well as existing JSON and ZIP files.
When supplied for a directory, EG_CONFIG_EXPECTED_SHA256 covers ordered filenames and the SHA-256 of each file's exact bytes.
security: Live apply uses the existing authenticated preview and apply API. Public startup diagnostics retain their sanitized aggregate shape.
knownLimitations: Bundles commit individually. An unsuccessful directory run can include successful applies.
Standalone directory startup and live apply target the default tenant. Existing platform-scoped single-file bootstrap objects require ownership review before switching input modes.
rollback: Apply the previous reviewed configuration through the existing preview and apply workflow.
validation: PostgreSQL integration verified that startup and live CLI apply both continue after a failed middle bundle, and that live apply updates the same records created at startup.
Startup regression tests cover existing single-file JSON and ZIP inputs, validation mode, and directory hash verification.
